name: PageFairy — Order Notification

nodes.name: Send Upsell Message

parameters.text: Order confirmed! 📦 Want us to build your PageFairy brand setup while you wait? Reply MAGIC to add Magic Wand+ for $99.

nodes.notes: Exact copy from pf-ops.txt — upsell trigger on Stripe payment_success

notes: Triggered by Hono POST to https://n8n.pagefairy.com/webhook/new-order after ORDER record is created in Airtable. Expected body: { campaign_id, customer_email, amount_cents, current_units, goal_units }. Requires env vars: AIRTABLE_BASE_ID, AIRTABLE_TOKEN. Requires n8n credential: PageFairy Telegram (stores TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN).
